# Preview your first form

**Preview** is the last step of your first-form tutorial. Use it to check layout, validation, and button behavior from a user's perspective.

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=add-fields-validated&view=mui'); return false;">Open form with validation in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

## Open Preview

1. Click **Preview** in the center header.
2. The button label changes to **Edit**.

<img src="/assets/guide/first-form/highlight-preview.png" alt="Preview control in the header toolbar on the first-form walkthrough." />

## Run through your checklist

<img src="/assets/guide/first-form/add-fields-with-button-plain.png" alt="Finished first form with required fields and a Save button before Preview." />

1. Fill each required field.
2. Leave a required field empty and confirm the error message.
3. Click your **Save** or submit button if configured.
4. Use **Validate** in the left panel to force validation.

## Return to Edit

<img src="/assets/guide/first-form/highlight-edit-button.png" alt="Edit button in the header to leave Preview." />

1. Click **Edit**.
2. Fix any issues found during Preview.

## Check the result

- Side panels for authoring are hidden or replaced by preview tools.
- Field values you type in Preview appear in the **Data** section.

## Summary

**Preview** shows the user view. **Edit** shows the design view. Retest required fields, validation, and buttons before handoff. Use
the [testing checklist](/preview-and-handoff/testing-checklist-before-handoff) before release.

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=add-fields-with-button&view=mui'); return false;">Open finished first form in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the completed form from this article.

:::
